brief:
Dr Abu Sittah, a British-Palestinian surgeon working in Beirut, treats children severely wounded by Israeli attacks, according to Middle East Eye. The physician describes the pediatric injuries he encounters as uniformly catastrophic in nature, with little variation in the severity of trauma cases passing through his care.

The report documents Dr Abu Sittah's medical practice in Lebanon amid ongoing hostilities. His work addresses the physical toll of conflict on the country's youngest population, treating injuries sustained across a range of attack types. The surgeon's account provides a clinical perspective on civilian casualties among minors in the region.

title: British-Palestinian surgeon treats severe war wounds in Lebanese children
